title: Orbital Archive in Rose Twilight

prompt: Cinematic 35mm Panavision anamorphic shot, interior of a zero-gravity botanical orbital station at sunset, delicate pink cherry blossom petals drifting weightlessly through golden hour light shafts, dust motes glowing, soft atmospheric haze, 8k resolution, photorealistic, subtle camera push-in, shallow depth of field, f/1.8, warm rose and copper color grading, highly detailed architectural glass --ar 16:9 --v 6.1 --stylize 250
negativePrompt: low resolution, jittery motion, abrupt cuts, overexposed blown out highlights, warped geometry, plastic skin, distorted reflections, cartoon, 3D CGI render look
creationNotes: For best results in Runway Gen-3 Alpha, upload the initial Midjourney frame as First Frame and specify: 'Slow smooth push-in along the optical axis, zero abrupt acceleration, preserve fine petal particles'. Keep motion score between 2 and 4 to avoid temporal warp.

title: Zero-G Iridescent Silk Motion

prompt: High fashion editorial film still, haute couture model draped in multilayered iridescent translucent organza, floating suspended in mid-air surrounded by gentle pink-tinted vapor, Hasselblad medium format portrait, 85mm lens, f/2.0, Rembrandt studio lighting with soft rose fill and rim accents, fabric undulating fluidly like marine silk, hyper-detailed textile weave --ar 9:16 --v 6.1
